reply_text: I replied to Dana in our DM: send the truck to Bay 41. She told me herself in a DM on Oct 14 that Bay 41 is her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Lantern project from now on. Nothing in the channels she belongs to says otherwise. I also suggested she check with the site before Thursday to make sure the bay is free. I didn't share the note anywhere else.
